heading: MIN II - Legacy

text: The MIN II, a member of the M II family of protection relays, is a microprocessor based relay that provides ground directional protection on distributed networks at any voltage level and backup/auxiliary ground directional protection for transformers, generators and motors. Additionally, it can be used to create a separate directional comparison ground scheme in pilot channels used for distance relaying.
